name: density
description: The compact density is one switch for the whole app: the chrome and the pages shrink together.

steps.title: Settings
steps.expression: const field = document.getElementById('density'); field.value = 'compact'; field.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return field.value;
steps.why: the density is changed to compact
the app has a moment to apply the density
the tab strip is the compact height

steps.title: Settings
steps.why: the settings page reads the same density

steps.title: Settings
steps.expression: const field = document.getElementById('density'); field.value = 'comfortable'; field.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); document.getElementById('save').click(); return true;
steps.why: the density goes back to comfortable
the app has a moment to apply the density
the tab strip is the comfortable height again
